description: This file defines mock or fuzzing implementations of various classes related to Android's SurfaceFlinger scheduler components, including clocks, VSync trackers, dispatchers, layers, and modulators, for testing or fuzzing purposes.

classes.name: FuzzImplClock
classes.description: A mock clock returning a fixed time for testing purposes.

classes.name: ClockWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around a shared pointer to a Clock, delegating now() calls.

classes.name: FakeClock
classes.description: A clock implementation that can advance time manually, used for testing.

classes.name: FuzzImplLayer
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Layer for fuzzing/testing.

classes.name: FuzzImplVSyncTracker
classes.description: A mock VSync tracker that provides fixed or predictable VSync timing.

classes.name: FuzzImplVSyncDispatch
classes.description: A stub implementation of VSync dispatch for testing.

classes.name: ControllableClock
classes.description: A clock that can be manually controlled and used for testing timing-dependent code.

classes.name: FuzzImplVsyncModulator
classes.description: A mock Vsync modulator for testing synchronization.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns a fixed or current time, depending on implementation.

methods.name: addVsyncTimestamp
methods.description: Records a VSync timestamp, always returns true in mock.

methods.name: nextAnticipatedVSyncTimeFrom
methods.description: Predicts next VSync time from a given point.

methods.name: currentPeriod
methods.description: Returns the current VSync period.

methods.name: setPeriod
methods.description: Sets the VSync period.

methods.name: resetModel
methods.description: Resets internal VSync model state.

methods.name: needsMoreSamples
methods.description: Indicates if more samples are needed for VSync tracking.

methods.name: isVSyncInPhase
methods.description: Checks if VSync is in phase with a given frame rate.

methods.name: setRenderRate
methods.description: Sets the rendering frame rate.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for VSync events.

methods.name: unregisterCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a VSync callback.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a VSync callback.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a scheduled VSync callback.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled VSync callback.

methods.name: alarmAt
methods.description: Sets an alarm at a specific time.

methods.name: alarmCancel
methods.description: Cancels any set alarm.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs internal state for debugging.

methods.name: advanceTime
methods.description: Advances the clock by a specified duration.

methods.name: advanceToNextCallback
methods.description: Advances time to the next scheduled callback and executes it.

methods.name: advanceBy
methods.description: Advances the clock by a specified amount and triggers callback if conditions are met.

methods.name: setLag
methods.description: Sets a lag parameter affecting callback timing.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles the death of a binder in the Vsync modulator.
